recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-19335 unless a future Patient Care decision reopens the broader Goal.addresses scope question.
issue_request: FHIR-19335 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request to add Reference(MedicationRequest) as a supported target for Goal.addresses, because medication requests can be interventions that address a goal.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to commit 2c912ff9559a2b6d52b0fbb709228154ae5908aa, which added MedicationRequest to Goal.addresses in source/goal/goal-spreadsheet.xml and marked the row GF#19335. The current source conversion preserved that result in source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml with GF#19335 in committee notes and MedicationRequest in the targetProfile list.
additional_context: Goal is active in source/fhir.ini. Later same-element issues added Procedure and NutritionIntake. FHIR-40777 later considered removing MedicationRequest and other intervention/request resources from Goal.addresses, but Patient Care resolved not to remove them and instead clarified the definition to resources that provide context for why the goal exists.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scope source already implements FHIR-19335 and later work-group review supports retaining MedicationRequest.
